justification: Changes where intake writes in dcp_chapter_registry and which file/hash the extractor, approver, watchdog and commit worker read; a wrong read serves rules judged against the wrong file. Not above: no served rule text is changed by this PR.

pre_impl.existing_data: dcp_chapter_registry (571 active rows): six new nullable staged_* columns; all NULL until an amendment is received, so every existing row reads exactly as before via COALESCE.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: If migration 125 is not applied, the new SELECTs fail loudly (undefined column) rather than read a wrong file. It must be applied before merge.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Only chapters that already serve a file (r2_current_path and content_hash set, not spatial/inert) are staged. First loads still go live directly.
pre_impl.external_source_error: Council 403/429/5xx paths are unchanged; staging happens after a successful download and R2 upload only.
pre_impl.frontend_type: No. /internal/dcp-review reads q.source_content_hash from the queue, which now carries the staged hash; shape unchanged.
pre_impl.user_failure_mode: A chapter whose commit does not run keeps serving the previous file and rules (live page unchanged) instead of a mismatched pair.

functions.name: stage_file
functions.input: registry row id plus the new file's R2 path, version label, public URL, hash and length
functions.output: six staged_* columns on the dcp_chapter_registry row; the live columns are not written at all
functions.if_none: content_length may be None and is stored as NULL; publish later keeps the live length through COALESCE

functions.name: publish_staged
functions.input: council slug and chapter_key naming one registry row, called inside the commit transaction
functions.output: True when the live columns were set from the staged ones and staging cleared, else False
functions.if_none: nothing staged means the UPDATE matches zero rows and it returns False with no change made

queries.purpose: effective hash/path/version for extractor, approver, commit, watchdog
queries.where_clause: unchanged; SELECT list uses COALESCE(staged_*, live)

break_it.scenario: Amendment staged, then the council file changes again before commit
break_it.what_happens: old staged review rows no longer match the effective hash
break_it.how: r2_monitor replaces the staged file; commit currency guard refuses approved rows whose source hash differs

break_it.scenario: Live proofs are cleared at commit (path change fires 078/079/111/112) and a proof script fails
break_it.what_happens: rules of that chapter are hidden until the proof scripts are re-run, not served wrong
break_it.how: commit worker already runs citation, page and council_quote scripts straight after; a gap of minutes remains and is NOT closed by this PR
break_it.repro: commit a staged chapter and read dq_probe_live --id DQ-145 before the proof scripts finish

break_it.scenario: Direct-to-live extraction (not review) commits rules while a file is staged
break_it.what_happens: rules and file would disagree if the file were not published with them
break_it.how: scripts/dcp_extract_changed.py calls publish_staged in the same transaction as the rule writes, before marking the chapter extracted

break_it.scenario: Chapter is shared by two registry rows pointing at one PDF while one is staged
break_it.what_happens: shared-PDF range check would find no sibling and treat the chapter as owning its file
break_it.how: scripts/dcp_extract_changed.py shared-PDF query matches COALESCE(staged_r2_path, r2_current_path)
break_it.repro: grep COALESCE(staged_r2_path in dcp_extract_changed.py near the shared-PDF lookup

break_it.scenario: Monitor sees the same staged file every run
break_it.what_happens: it would upload a new version and re-flag the chapter each day
break_it.how: scripts/r2_monitor.py compares new_hash with staged_content_hash before the stored-hash check and records only the headers

falsifiable_check.fails_when: MUTATION measured on this branch: replacing the staging condition in r2_monitor with `if False:` (re-pointing live again) makes 2 of 10 tests fail (amendment staged / newer file replaces staged); restored: 10 passed.
falsifiable_check.observed_red: Measured on this branch: with the staging condition in r2_monitor.py replaced by `if False:`, 2 of 10 tests in tests/test_staged_intake.py failed (test_an_amendment_is_staged_and_the_live_row_does_not_move and test_a_newer_file_replaces_the_staged_one_with_a_later_version_label); restored, 10 passed.

post_merge.manual_verify: Apply migrations/125 to Supabase BEFORE merge (additive); then stage one real amendment and confirm live link and DQ-145 unchanged
